comply-in.span: Every pipeline covers the full data journey: document parsing, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and LLM generation. No gaps.
Semantic chunking with overlap, not fixed token splits, to preserve context and improve retrieval accuracy.
Hybrid search (dense + sparse) and re-ranking are evaluated and tuned per dataset for production recall.
LangSmith tracing across every stage — ingestion, retrieval, generation — so pipeline behavior is fully visible.

p: A RAG pipeline is a production system that ingests documents, chunks them, embeds them into a vector store, retrieves relevant context at query time, and passes that context to an LLM to generate grounded answers. It covers the full stack from data ingestion to final generation, with tuning at every stage for accuracy, latency, and cost.

sec-head.h2: RAG pipeline consultant vs RAG build agency

td: Lower, direct rate, no team overhead
Higher, includes team and account management

vs-agency.p: Most RAG pipeline projects — a specific ingestion strategy, a retrieval optimization, a full production pipeline — are well within scope for a single experienced developer working directly with you. An agency's advantage shows up when a project genuinely needs several specialists working in parallel on a larger product, not for the RAG engineering itself.
